title: 一束光的形状
direction: 方向：陶瓶由一条连续壁线闭合而成——左壁自瓶口 x=698 向下、右壁自 x=874 向下，两壁之间最宽处取瓶腹，颈壁与瓶腹共用同一条曲线，不再分成"圆环 + 截断的瓶身"。瓶口中心 x=786 与瓶腹中轴（约 x=785）重合，口沿椭圆在该两点切于颈壁外缘，因此口沿是瓶身的顶面而非悬空圆环；口内是向下的暗色椭圆，两处枝条入水暗斑落在口内偏左下，对应画面中两枝橄榄叶的实际插入位置。颈壁受光面自瓶身左侧亮面连续上升到口沿，与落在瓶左的光带同侧。瓶底 y=702 压在原投影中心 y=716 的软阴影上，另有紧贴瓶底的一条窄接触影，避免瓶身悬浮。窗光、桌面色带、枝叶、落片与全部文字版式保持原样，画面仍为 1440×900 横向完整 SVG，无脚本与外部资源。
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1440" height="900" viewBox="0 0 1440 900" role="img" aria-labelledby="t d"><title id="t">一束光的形状</title><desc id="d">午后阳光从右上高处斜落，在暖纸色墙面上形成一束被窗棂切成数条的硬边光带。光带向右下平移，被桌上一只陶土高颈花瓶的中段打断：瓶身左侧更亮，右腹留出一条未受光的暗带。瓶中插两枝墨绿橄榄叶。概念示例作品，品牌与项目均为虚构。</desc>
<defs>
<linearGradient id="paper" x1="0" y1="0" x2=".3" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#f1eadb"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#e8dfcc"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#dbcfb7"/></linearGradient>
<linearGradient id="sun" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2=".5"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff9e6"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#f6e8c4"/></linearGradient>
<linearGradient id="wallFall" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#6d6553" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#6d6553" stop-opacity=".13"/></linearGradient>
<linearGradient id="clay" x1=".12" y1="0" x2=".9" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#c4613f"/><stop offset=".3" stop-color="#dd9a74"/><stop offset=".58" stop-color="#bd6746"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#8f452e"/></linearGradient>
<linearGradient id="clayRim" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#8a4029"/><stop offset=".45" stop-color="#b85539"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#7a3621"/></linearGradient>
<linearGradient id="table" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#d6c5a6"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#bfaa88"/></linearGradient>
<linearGradient id="leafA" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#3d5438"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#233320"/></linearGradient>
<linearGradient id="leafB" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#5d764c"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#3c5137"/></linearGradient>
<radialGradient id="glow" cx=".5" cy=".5" r=".5"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fffaf0" stop-opacity=".8"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#fffaf0" stop-opacity="0"/></radialGradient>
<filter id="soft" x="-30%" y="-60%" width="160%" height="240%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="9"/></filter>
<filter id="soft2" x="-30%" y="-40%" width="160%" height="180%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3.4"/></filter>
<!-- 陶瓶外轮廓：颈壁与瓶腹由同一条壁线构成，单条闭合成形 -->

</defs>
